rows.text: The transcript of the sitting of 29 June 2010 ('Aho: 29.06.2010') opens with the Sergeant-at-Arms announcing the Speaker of the Fale Alea ('Me'a mai e 'Eiki Sea 'o e Fale Alea. ('Eiki Nopele Tu'ilakepa)'); the roll lists ''Eiki Sea 'o e Fale Alea. 'Eiki Nopele Tu'ilakepa - Fakafofonga Nopele Fika 1 'o Vava'u'; and petition No. 9 of 2010 is addressed to 'Lord Tu'ilakepa, 'Eiki Sea 'o e Fale Alea'.
rows.locator: Title and date line; opening announcement and roll call; petition No. 9 of 2010 (Tohi Tangi fika 9)
rows.uncertainty: A contemporaneous attestation of him presiding on 29 June 2010; it is not an end, and whether he continued to the December 2010 Interim Speaker is not stated. The government posting is dated 7 July 2010.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation).
